arxiv-1702-03815.title: An oracle-based attack on CAPTCHAs protected against oracle attacks.
arxiv-1702-03815.creator: Carlos Javier Hernández-Castro, María D. R-Moreno, David F. Barrero, Shujun Li
arxiv-1702-03815.description: Abstract CAPTCHAs/HIPs are security mechanisms that try to prevent automatic abuse of services. They are susceptible to learning attacks in which attackers can use them as oracles. Kwon and Cha presented recently a novel algorithm that intends to avoid such learning attacks and “detect all bots” [ 6 ] .

arxiv-1903-04040.title: Measurement of electroweak production of a \PW \PW boson in association with two jets in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-1903-04040.description: Abstract A measurement is presented of electroweak (EW) production of a \PW \PW boson in association with two jets in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV . The data sample was recorded by the CMS Collaboration at the LHC and corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 35.9 \fbinv .

arxiv-2104-13477.title: Branching optical frequency transfer with enhanced post automatic phase noise cancellation
arxiv-2104-13477.creator: Ruimin Xue, Liang Hu, Jianguo Shen, Jianping Chen, Guiling Wu
arxiv-2104-13477.description: Abstract We present a technique for coherence transfer of laser light through a branching fiber link, where the optical phase noise induced by environmental perturbations via the fiber link is passively compensated by remote users without the requirements of any active servo components.

arxiv-2107-08838.title: On the distribution of the Hodge locus
arxiv-2107-08838.creator: Gregorio Baldi, Bruno Klingler, and Emmanuel Ullmo
arxiv-2107-08838.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gregorio Baldi, Bruno Klingler, and Emmanuel Ullmo. Given a polarizable ℤ \mathbb{Z} -variation of Hodge structures 𝕍 \mathbb{V} over a complex smooth quasi-projective base S S , a classical result of Cattani, Deligne and Kaplan says that its Hodge locus (i.e. the locus where exceptional Hodge tensors appear) is a countable union of irreducible algebraic subvarieties of S S , called the special subvarieties for 𝕍 \mathbb{V} .

arxiv-2108-10436.title: Rewrite Rule Inference Using Equality Saturation Conference: ; 2021; USA CCS: Software and its engineering General programming languages CCS: Social and professional topics History of programming languages
arxiv-2108-10436.creator: Chandrakana Nandi, Max Willsey, Amy Zhu, Yisu Remy Wang, Brett Saiki, Adam Anderson, Adriana Schulz, Dan Grossman, Zachary Tatlock
arxiv-2108-10436.description: Abstract . Many compilers, synthesizers, and theorem provers rely on rewrite rules to simplify expressions or prove equivalences. Developing rewrite rules can be difficult: rules may be subtly incorrect, profitable rules are easy to miss, and rulesets must be rechecked or extended whenever semantics are tweaked.

arxiv-2304-13408.title: Quantum-circuit algorithms for many-body topological invariant and Majorana zero mode
arxiv-2304-13408.creator: Takanori Sugimoto
arxiv-2304-13408.description: Abstract Topological states of matter are promising resources for composing fault-tolerant quantum computers, advancing beyond the limitations of current noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. To enable this progress, a deep understanding of topological phenomena within actual quantum computing platforms is essential. However, existing quantum-circuit algorithms to examine topological properties remain limited.

arxiv-2307-13003.title: Quantum GraviElectro Dynamics
arxiv-2307-13003.creator: Yoshimasa Kurihara
arxiv-2307-13003.description: Abstract This report presents a possible attempt at renormalisable quantum gravity based on the standard BRST quantisation used for Yang–Mills theory. We have provided the BRST invariant Lagrangian of the gravitationally interacting U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) gauge theory, namely the Quantum GraviElectro Dynamics (QGED ), including the gauge fixing and the ghost Lagrangian.

arxiv-2311-08709.title: Fermionic steering is not nonlocal in the background of dilaton black hole
arxiv-2311-08709.creator: Shu-Min Wu, Jin-Xuan Li, Xiao-Ying Jiang, Xiao-Wei Teng, Xiao-Li Huang, Jianbo Lu
arxiv-2311-08709.description: Abstract We study the redistribution of the fermionic steering and the relation among fermionic Bell nonlocality, steering, and entanglement in the background of the Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger dilaton black hole. We analyze the meaning of the fermionic steering in terms of the Bell inequality in curved spacetime.

arxiv-2412-08486.title: Learning Flow Fields in Attention for Controllable Person Image Generation
arxiv-2412-08486.creator: Zijian Zhou, Shikun Liu, Xiao Han, Haozhe Liu, Kam Woh Ng, Tian Xie, Yuren Cong, Hang Li, Mengmeng Xu, Juan-Manuel Pérez-Rúa, Aditya Patel, Tao Xiang, Miaojing Shi, Sen He
arxiv-2412-08486.description: Abstract Controllable person image generation aims to generate a person image conditioned on reference images, allowing precise control over the person’s appearance or pose. However, prior methods often distort fine-grained textural details from the reference image, despite achieving high overall image quality. We attribute these distortions to inadequate attention to corresponding regions in the reference image.

arxiv-2503-10813.title: Complex Riemannian Spacetime, Removal of Black Hole Singularities And Black Hole Paradoxes
arxiv-2503-10813.creator: J. W. Moffat
arxiv-2503-10813.description: Abstract An approach is presented to resolve key paradoxes in black hole physics through the application of complex Riemannian spacetime. We extend the Schwarzschild metric into the complex domain, employing contour integration techniques to remove singularities while preserving essential features of the original solution. A new regularized radial coordinate is introduced, leading to a singularity-free description of black hole interiors.

arxiv-2601-18438.title: UrgentMOS: Unified Multi-Metric and Preference Learning for Robust Speech Quality Assessment
arxiv-2601-18438.creator: Wei Wang, Wangyou Zhang, Chenda Li, Jiahe Wang, Samuele Cornell, Marvin Sach, Kohei Saijo, Yihui Fu, Zhaoheng Ni, Bing Han, Xun Gong, Mengxiao Bi, Tim Fingscheidt, Shinji Watanabe, Yanmin Qian
arxiv-2601-18438.description: Abstract Automatic speech quality assessment has become increasingly important as modern speech generation systems continue to advance, while human listening tests remain costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. Most existing learning-based assessment models rely primarily on scarce human-annotated mean opinion score (MOS) data, which limits robustness and generalization, especially when training across heterogeneous datasets.

arxiv-2602-02474.title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
arxiv-2602-02474.creator: Haozhen Zhang, Quanyu Long, Jianzhu Bao, Tao Feng, Weizhi Zhang, Haodong Yue, Wenya Wang
arxiv-2602-02474.description: Abstract Most Large Language Model (LLM) agent memory systems rely on a small set of static, hand-designed operations for extracting memory. These fixed procedures hard-code human priors about what to store and how to revise memory, making them rigid under diverse interaction patterns and inefficient on long histories.

pmc-10482337.title: Establishment of paternal methylation imprint at the H19/Igf2 imprinting control region
pmc-10482337.creator: Ji Liao, Sangmin Song, Samuel Gusscott, Zhen Fu, Ivan VanderKolk, Brianna M. Busscher, Kin H. Lau, Julie Brind’Amour, Piroska E. Szabó
pmc-10482337.description: The insulator model explains the workings of the H19 and Igf2 imprinted domain in the soma, where insulation of the Igf2 promoter from its enhancers occurs by CTCF in the maternally inherited unmethylated chromosome but not the paternally inherited methylated allele.

pmc-10596959.title: 2.H. Pro/con workshop: Whether AI will decrease health inequalities or deepen them?
pmc-10596959.creator: Organised by: EUPHA-ETH, Chair persons: Farhang Tahzib (EUPHA-ETH), Monica Brînzac (EUPHAnxt)
pmc-10596959.description: Reasons for the workshopEvery new health technology is hoped to help address leading public health problems. Undoubtedly, AI technologies can be useful in many ways in healthcare systems and health care delivery. For example, AI algorithms can help diagnostic process while reducing waiting times and costs. Virtual health assistants can provide personalised health advice regardless of race or socio-economic status.

pmc-10632909.creator: Guillermo Romero-Farina, Santiago Aguadé-Bruix, Ignacio Ferreira González
pmc-10632909.description: ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to create a new Vall d’Hebron Risk Score-II (VH-RS-II) for non-fatal myocardial infarction (MI) and/or cardiac death (CD), excluding patients with coronary revascularisation (CR) during the follow-up.MethodsWe analysed 5215 consecutive patients underwent gated single photon emission CT (SPECT); 2960 patients (age 64.2±11, male 58.

pmc-11326036.title: Risk factors of transient and permanent hypoparathyroidism after thyroidectomy: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11326036.creator: Kang Ning, Yongchao Yu, Xinyi Zheng, Zhenyu Luo, Zan Jiao, Xinyu Liu, Yiyao Wang, Yarong Liang, Zhuoqi Zhang, Xianglin Ye, Weirui Wu, Jian Bu, Qiaorong Chen, Fuxiang Cheng, Lizhen Liu, Mingjie Jiang, Ankui Yang, Tong Wu, Zhongyuan Yang
pmc-11326036.description: Background:Postoperative hypoparathyroidism (hypoPT) is a common complication following thyroid surgery. However, current research findings on the risk factors for post-thyroid surgery hypoPT are not entirely consistent, and the same risk factors may have different impacts on transient and permanent hypoPT.

pmc-11447920.title: Life beyond Fritz: On the Detachment of Electrolytic Bubbles
pmc-11447920.creator: Çayan Demirkır, Jeffery A. Wood, Detlef Lohse, Dominik Krug
pmc-11447920.description: We present an experimental study on detachment characteristics of hydrogen bubbles during electrolysis. Using a transparent (Pt or Ni) electrode enables us to directly observe the bubble contact line and bubble size. Based on these quantities we determine other parameters such as the contact angle and volume through solutions of the Young–Laplace equation.

pmc-11567907.title: The Daily Mile reduces depressive and anxiety symptoms in school-going Ugandan adolescents aged 16-17
pmc-11567907.creator: Davy Vancampfort, James Mugisha, Tine Van Damme
pmc-11567907.description: Introductionschool-based physical activity (PA) programs such as The Daily Mile (TDM) might be vital in the prevention and treatment of mental health problems in adolescents in low-income countries. The aim of this single-arm non-controlled pilot intervention study was to investigate TDM on symptoms of anxiety and depression in adolescents aged 16-17 years in Uganda.

pmc-11655572.title: New finding on a migratory bird, the fowl tick Argas (Persicargas) persicus (Oken, 1818), in Italy
pmc-11655572.creator: Michela Menegon, Francesca Casale, Elisa Mancuso, Marco Di Luca, Francesco Severini, Federica Monaco, Luciano Toma
pmc-11655572.description: Migratory birds reach Europe from sub-Saharan Africa, and some avian species may harbor and transport infected ectoparasites, mainly ticks, native to the territories of departure. In 2022, a project focused on identifying the introduction of pathogens in Italy from Africa via migratory birds represented an important opportunity to investigate this particular route of tick dispersal.

pmc-12448427.title: Bile acid metabolism and hepatocellular carcinoma: mechanisms of drug resistance and intervention strategies
pmc-12448427.creator: Yan Lu, Xiaochen Feng, Zhijie Wang, Minghao Zou, Zheqi Xu, Qianjia Liu, Wenjin Chen, Jin Ding, Hui Liu
pmc-12448427.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the predominant malignant liver tumor, characterized by high morbidity, mortality, and rapid progression, and it ranks among the leading causes of cancer-related fatalities worldwide. Its treatment is facing the severe challenge of resistance to targeted drugs and immunotherapy.

pmc-12538456.title: Ultrasonically activated peroxymonosulfate oxidation for advanced water treatment: Cavitation mechanism, free radical generation and process simulation
pmc-12538456.creator: Lucheng Zhang, Mingqing Zhang, Gang Kang, Zihui Xu
pmc-12538456.description: The persistent presence of recalcitrant organic pollutants in aquatic environments highlights the urgent need for efficient and sustainable water treatment technologies. This study investigated the application of the ultrasonically activated peroxymonosulfate system for organic pollutant degradation, with a focus on elucidating its cavitation mechanism, radical generation, and multiphysics characteristics. Experimental results demonstrated that the US-PMS system is pH-tolerant, achieving 92.

pmc-12566217.title: Low-Dose Subarachnoid Anesthesia Combined with PENG and FLCN Blocks Reduces Hypotensive Episodes Without Compromising Anesthetic Depth and Duration in Hip Fracture Surgery: A Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-12566217.creator: Daniel Salgado-García, Agustín Díaz-Álvarez, José L. González-Rodríguez, María R. López-Iglesias, Eduardo Sánchez-López, Manuel J. Sánchez-Ledesma, María I. Martínez-Trufero
pmc-12566217.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: In the context of hip fracture surgeries, episodes of hypotension are common, and have been associated in various studies with increased complications and mortality. The latest clinical guidelines recommend close hemodynamic management. Our research team hypothesized that the use of peripheral nerve blocks in this surgery could help adjust the doses of subarachnoid anesthesia for these procedures, thereby limiting the hypotensive episodes, without compromising an adequate depth and duration of intraoperative anesthesia.

pmc-12660452.title: Pulsed power treatment demonstrates complete inactivation of anisakid larvae in agar penetration and rabbit infection tests
pmc-12660452.creator: Hiromu Sugiyama, Mitsuko Shiroyama, Yasuyuki Morishima, Douyan Wang, Takao Namihira
pmc-12660452.description: Anisakiasis is a foodborne zoonosis caused by ingesting raw seafood containing anisakid larvae. Its global incidence has increased with rising seafood consumption, highlighting the need for effective prevention methods. While freezing at −20 °C for 24 h is a standard preventive measure, it compromises seafood quality.

pmc-13191243.title: Skin lesions revealing a loco-regional and systemic metallosis
pmc-13191243.creator: Marie Le Roux, Alain Dupuy, Martine Ropert, Adélie Perrot, Marie Loisel, Louise Gouvrion
pmc-13191243.description: sually confined to the joint and periprosthetic space, rare cases of extracapsular metal particle migration have been described, including cutaneous involvement usually manifesting as skin pigmentation.1,2 Systemic toxicity due to elevated metal ion levels is another possible but uncommon complication.3,4 We report a case of a locoregional and systemic metallosis revealed by the skin, after a reverse shoulder arthroplasty.

pmc-13247098.title: Comparison of the long-term impact of laparoscopy and open surgery on the prognosis of patients with locally advanced gastric cancer
pmc-13247098.creator: Ming-cong Deng, Ken Chen, Qi-mei Bao, Yi-xing Huang, Chun-kai Zhang, Yu-ke Zhong, Han-yi He, Dan Zu, Chen Liang, Hai-dong Liu, Yang-chan Hu, Guo-xia Liu, Yan-hua He, Wei-xin Wu, Ji Jing, Yin Shi, Yi-an Du, Yao-shu Teng, Zu Ye, Xiang-dong Cheng
pmc-13247098.description: Currently, the choice of surgical procedure for patients with locally advanced gastric cancer remains controversial. This study aimed to investigate the difference in prognosis between laparoscopy and open surgery in patients with locally advanced gastric cancer and explored the potential patients suitable for laparoscopy.

pmc-13543828.title: The complete chloroplast genome of Heterostemma pingtaoi (Apocynaceae)
pmc-13543828.creator: Jishi Liu, Yong Yang, Kai Zhang
pmc-13543828.description: Heterostemma pingtaoi, a species endemic to Hainan Island, China, was discovered and formally described in the family Apocynaceae in 2010. However, genetic and evolutionary information on the genus Heterostemma remains poorly understood. Here, we report the complete chloroplast (cp) genome sequence of H. pingtaoi.
